start.text: Yes yes, new joinee, I know, Divya madam told. Offer letter? Degree? Good. Name? … Spell it.

choices.text: It's on the offer letter, sir.

letter.text: Letter is letter, system is system. System wants spelling. Spell it.

spelt.text: (Typing with two fingers.) Okay. Photo — look here, don't smile, this is office not Instagram. … Printing. Card is coming. Don't lose it, replacement is five hundred.

card.text: Here. Lanyard is blue for employees, red for vendors, green for interns. You are blue. Go, Divya madam is waiting. Second floor.

done.text: Card working? Good. Don't lose it. Five hundred.
